## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D anime-inspired fighting game for phones and tablets, with the feel of *Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero*.

## Requirements
- Build immediately without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Support phone/tablet touch controls and responsive layouts.

## Decisions
- Created an original arena brawler, “KI CLASH — Warrior’s Ascent,” with Goku and Vegeta-inspired characters, rather than using licensed character assets.
- Built the fighters and arena from Three.js primitives; gameplay includes movement, strikes, ki blasts, charging, dashing, an AI opponent, health, timer, pause, and win/lose states.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the Three.js game, menu, HUD, keyboard and touch controls in `src/main.js` and `src/style.css`.
- Added Vite project setup in `package.json` and `index.html`; `npm install` completed.
- `npm run build` succeeds.
- Opened the game in Playwright and saved/inspected menu and gameplay screenshots.

### Active
- Final review and polish; a recent arena seam adjustment in `src/main.js` has not been re-tested.
- Check browser console for any remaining issues; observed 404 for `/favicon.ico` and WebGL performance warnings.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `npm run build` after the latest seam edit.
2. Reload the browser, verify the arena and gameplay, and check responsive mobile layout if practical.
3. Optionally add a favicon to eliminate the observed 404.
4. Summarize the finished game and note the original-character assumption.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Three.js scene, fighters, controls, combat, AI, HUD, and game loop.
- `src/style.css`: Menu, fight HUD, and responsive mobile/tablet styling.
- `index.html`: App shell and canvas.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `screenshots/menu.jpg`: Captured menu check.
- `screenshots/fight.jpg`: Captured gameplay check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Development server was started with `npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0`; app is at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Playwright screenshots were saved at `screenshots/menu.jpg` and `screenshots/fight.jpg`.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D anime-inspired arena fighting game for phones and tablets, with the feel of *Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero*.

## Requirements
- Build immediately without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Support phone/tablet touch controls and responsive layouts.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) for visual checks.

## Decisions
- Created original, Goku- and Vegeta-inspired characters rather than using licensed character assets.
- Built “KI CLASH — Warrior’s Ascent” with Three.js primitives and a Vite setup.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the menu, 3D arena and fighters, combat, AI opponent, health/ki, timer, pause and win/lose states in `src/main.js`.
- Added keyboard and touch controls and responsive styling in `src/style.css`.
- Confirmed the production build succeeded after the arena seam adjustment.
- Checked the desktop menu and gameplay in Playwright; saved `screenshots/menu.jpg` and `screenshots/fight.jpg`.
- Opened the app in mobile emulation; the page loaded with zero errors.
- Added an SVG favicon and linked it in `index.html`.

### Active
- Final verification after the favicon change; mobile visual layout has not yet been screenshot-checked.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `npm run build` after the favicon addition.
2. Check the mobile layout and gameplay visually if practical; save/read a current JPEG screenshot.
3. Report the completed game and briefly note the original-character assumption.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Three.js scene, fighters, controls, combat, AI, HUD, and game loop.
- `src/style.css`: Menu, fight HUD, and responsive mobile/tablet styling.
- `index.html`: App shell and favicon link.
- `public/favicon.svg`: App favicon.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `screenshots/menu.jpg`: Desktop menu visual check.
- `screenshots/fight.jpg`: Desktop gameplay visual check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Development server is available at `http://localhost:3002`.
- The last build passed with a Vite warning that the minified JS chunk exceeds 500 kB.
